text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a difficult god!
How much more does it need to rampage before it's had enough?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく、
世話の焼ける神様ね～！
どんだけ暴れ回れば気が済むってのよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text: *sob*... Mountain God, why won't you compose yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
山神様、
なかなか気を静めてくれませんね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
I suppose this much is not enough to abate the residual excitement
from the race. However, we cannot let it continue like this...
It seems this time be a fight to the death.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけ
レースの興奮が収まらない、
ということなのでしょう。
しかし、
このままにもしておけません……
次が死力を尽くした最後の戦いになりそうです。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we're near our limits on both sides of this battle.
If that's the case, we'll have to settle this soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
向こうもあたしたちも、
いい加減限界っぽいしね。
こうなりゃ
白黒はっきりつけてやるわ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, we're in the home stretch!
Let's give it everything we've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
これで最後です！！
みんなの力を全てぶつけましょう！！
